function_decisions.disposition: functions_without_instrument: legitimate state-layer function for this definition
function_decisions.reason: The defined function concerns real-estate broker/property-manager licensing for leasing, rent collection and deposit handling, statutory exemptions, trust duties and recovery of compensation. No distinct general federal licensure source is warranted by these activities. California licensing determines this branch; HUD approval of a management agent is a separate program eligibility/contract condition and does not confer a state broker license.

crosslayer_instruments.purpose: License-trigger acts, specified exemptions, compensation recovery and handling of trust funds.
Real estate regulatory duties, including trust-account controls.

conditional_federal_dependencies.reason: Owner selection and agency approval depend on project and mortgage/program status. Treat this as an additional approval gate for the selected program, independently of California licensure/exemption; do not add broker_licensing merely because the handbook concerns managers.

primary_sources.evidence: Official section identifies compensated leasing/renting and rent collection for another as broker acts.
Existing selected official chapter route contains licensing provisions and exceptions.
Opened23-page official Chapter2; paragraphs2.1–2.4 describe program-specific selection/approval and agent relationships, not general occupational licensure.

function_decisions.disposition: functions_without_instrument: legitimate state-layer function as expressly defined
function_decisions.reason: The function explicitly concerns the state unclaimed-property act as applied to an uncashed deposit refund or ordinary credit balance. Keep that state-holder branch separate from money already administered in bankruptcy or deposited with a federal court. Federal distribution/custody rules do not establish a general federal dormancy-and-remittance regime for a landlord's unpaid tenant refund.

Selected state reporting instructions/forms implement the statutory holder branch; choose the actual property type rather than treating every credit as a deposit.

scope_limit: This is a layer/function allocation decision, not a claim that federal law can never affect licensing or unclaimed property. A concrete federal program, bankruptcy/court-custody fact, preemption issue or interstate-priority dispute must invoke its own authority. No unrelated industry census or function-definition expansion performed.
